fact: A GSMA, REACH and UNHCR survey of 2,135 households in four refugee-hosting locations found about 78% of respondents (refugee and host community together) had SIM cards registered in their own name, though focus groups revealed barriers to registration in certain locations.

The World Bank ID4D diagnostic says nearly 90% of South Sudan's population lacks government-recognised identification, with women, internally displaced people, returnees and refugees disproportionately excluded.
The World Bank project paper states 448,243 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered in South Sudan as of March 2024, in over 21 locations.

The World Bank project paper says targeting and registration of beneficiaries of the SNSOP cash transfers, which expects 7,000 refugee households, has started using an MIS linked to a biometric registration tool and payment application.
system: SNSOP management information system with biometric registration tool
